questions.question: Why are signals important on a motorcycle?

options.text: They are not very useful because motorcycles are smaller than other vehicles.
They tell other drivers what you plan to do.
You only need to use them if other vehicles are nearby.
They are harder to use than signals on a car.

questions.correctAnswerText: They tell other drivers what you plan to do.
questions.explanation: As a motorcycle rider, you are more vulnerable. Use your turn signals to tell other drivers your plans. Always signal when you turn or change lanes, even if you think no one is nearby.

questions.question: When should you inspect your motorcycle?
questions.explanation: Check your motorcycle before every ride to prevent problems. Small mechanical issues on a motorcycle can cause serious trouble, unlike in a car.

questions.question: What color is a warning sign?

options.text: Yellow with black lettering or symbols

questions.correctAnswerText: Yellow with black lettering or symbols
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black lettering or symbols. They warn drivers about road conditions ahead.

questions.question: What should you do if a friend is drunk and wants to ride their motorcycle?
questions.explanation: Never let someone ride if they have been drinking. Do whatever you can to stop them. Take their keys if needed and arrange another way for them to get home.

questions.question: What should you do when riding on a slippery surface?
questions.explanation: Slow down on slippery surfaces. Use both brakes when stopping and avoid sudden movements.

questions.question: If you wait one hour per drink before riding, what happens?

options.text: You cannot be arrested for riding after drinking.
Alcohol will not affect your skills.
You will be safe if you ride slowly.

questions.explanation: Your body removes about one drink's worth of alcohol per hour. However, alcohol can build up in your system even if you drink slowly. This buildup can still harm your ability to ride safely.

questions.question: When does alcohol start to impair your abilities?

options.text: At about half the legal limit.

questions.explanation: Even one drink can affect your riding skills. You can be impaired below the legal limit. No amount of alcohol is safe before riding.

questions.question: How should a motorcycle rider choose their lane position?

options.text: Pick one spot in the lane and stay there.
Move around the lane to keep other drivers away.
Change position based on road and traffic conditions.
Do not worry about lane position.

questions.correctAnswerText: Change position based on road and traffic conditions.
questions.explanation: No single lane position is always best. Move your position based on what is happening on the road and around you.

questions.question: Why is riding next to a car dangerous?

options.text: You may be in the driver's blind spot.
It is only dangerous when the road is wet.
It makes driving easier for the other driver.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may be in the driver's blind spot.
questions.explanation: Riding next to another vehicle is unsafe. The driver may not see you in their blind spot. The car also blocks your escape route.

questions.question: How do you make the shortest and safest stop?

options.text: Let the front tire lock up.
Use both the front and rear brakes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Use both the front and rear brakes.
questions.explanation: Use both the front and rear brakes smoothly and evenly for the shortest and safest stop. Do not lock up either tire.

questions.question: Which of the following should you NOT check on your tires?
questions.explanation: Before riding, check your tire air pressure, tread, and general wear. You do not need to check flexibility.

questions.question: What is important to remember about motorcycle blind spots in traffic?

options.text: Motorcycles are too small to have blind spots.
Blind spots are too small to cause problems.
You must turn your head to check blind spots before changing lanes.
Motorcycles have only one blind spot.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn your head to check blind spots before changing lanes.
questions.explanation: Motorcycles have blind spots like all vehicles. Always turn your head to check for traffic in your blind spot before changing lanes.

questions.question: What type of sign is usually rectangular?
questions.explanation: Speed limit signs are rectangular with white backgrounds and black letters. These signs show traffic rules that you must follow.

questions.question: When stopped behind another vehicle, what should you do?

options.text: Get as close as possible to the vehicle.
Keep space between your motorcycle and the vehicle ahead.
Look for chances to squeeze through traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep space between your motorcycle and the vehicle ahead.
questions.explanation: Stay well behind the vehicle in front of you, even when stopped. This gives you room to escape if the vehicle backs up or if a vehicle behind you comes too close.

questions.question: What type of shoes should you wear when riding?

options.text: Shoes with long laces that hang out.

questions.explanation: Wear boots or shoes that are sturdy and high enough to cover and support your ankles. Keep heels short and tuck in laces so they don't catch on the motorcycle.

questions.question: How can your body get rid of alcohol?
questions.explanation: Only time can remove alcohol from your body. There are no quick ways to sober up.

questions.question: What must an eye or face shield do to work well?

options.text: Limit your side vision so you focus on the road.
Not allow eyeglasses or sunglasses to be worn.

questions.explanation: A good eye or face shield must fasten securely. It should also be scratch-free, resist damage, allow clear side views, let air through to prevent fogging, and fit eyeglasses or sunglasses.

questions.question: What should you check before riding?

options.text: How thick your seat cushion is.

questions.explanation: Before riding, check your tires, oil, fluid levels, lights, turn signals, brakes, mirrors, clutch, throttle, and horn.

questions.question: How should jackets and pants fit for the best protection?

options.text: Cover your arms and legs completely.
Be loose so they can flap in the wind.
Only partially cover your arms and legs.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cover your arms and legs completely.
questions.explanation: Jackets and pants should cover your arms and legs fully. They should fit snugly but allow you to move freely. Leather or synthetic materials offer the best protection.

questions.question: What should you do with shoelaces when riding?
questions.explanation: Tuck in shoelaces securely so they don't catch on your motorcycle.

questions.question: What is true about an approved helmet?

options.text: It lets you see clearly to the sides.
It has no labels or markings.

questions.correctAnswerText: It lets you see clearly to the sides.
questions.explanation: An approved helmet allows you to see clearly to the sides for safe riding. Approved helmets have labels with the maker's name, instructions, and safety standard information.

questions.question: How do you control the accelerator on a motorcycle?
questions.explanation: The accelerator is on the right handlebar grip. You control it with your right hand.

questions.question: When riding with a passenger, what should you do?

options.text: Let air out of the tires to handle the extra weight.
Do not tell passengers about dangers ahead.

questions.explanation: A motorcycle handles differently with a passenger. You need more space between you and the vehicle ahead.

questions.question: When riding behind a car, where should you ride?

options.text: Where the driver can see you in their rearview mirror.
As close to the car as possible.

questions.correctAnswerText: Where the driver can see you in their rearview mirror.
questions.explanation: Ride where the car driver can see you in their rearview mirror. This is usually in the center of the lane. Drivers check rearview mirrors more often than side mirrors, so this position keeps you safer.

questions.question: A motorcycle fits you properly if:

options.text: You can touch the ground with your feet while sitting on it.
You can reach the controls by stretching.
The handlebars are above your head.
Your feet cannot reach the foot pegs.

questions.correctAnswerText: You can touch the ground with your feet while sitting on it.
questions.explanation: A motorcycle fits you if your feet can touch the ground when you sit on it. You should be able to reach and use all the controls easily.
